summary: Explains how the Network Information Center at SRI handled documents for the ARPANET community. It says all information the center holds is open to any network participant, and it suggests ways sites can help the flow of documents. It is administrative guidance from 1971 rather than a technical protocol.

eli5.summary: A library explains its rules: anyone can borrow books, here is how we sort them, and here is how you can help us keep the shelves tidy.
